---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
artist_top <- billboard %>%
  count(artist, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 6) %>%
  pull(artist)

billboard %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date.entered)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) %>%
  filter(artist %in% artist_top, rank <= 10) %>%
  group_by(artist, year, week) %>%
  summarise(avg_rank = mean(rank), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = avg_rank, color = artist, group = artist)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Billboard Performance by Artist and Year",
    subtitle = "Average chart rank for the most active artists",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Chart Rank",
    color = "Artist"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
